category_title: Adolescents who experience academic shut-down and loss of confidence during middle school transitions
scenario_title: Academic shutdown during middle school transition
minimal_context: Tony is working on a math homework assignment in his sixth-grade classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your math homework and start working on the first section.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the paper away) I don't see the point of this. It's just boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to complete the assignment. What do you think the first step is?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I used to get Bs, but now in sixth grade everything is different.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read the instructions and do your best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, stuff started getting harder and I'm just quitting. I lost confidence a lot and it's all just failing anyway.

task.content: master the curriculum and complete homework

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: started quitting and then the grades like dropped drastically, everything went from like Bs to like not even Cs, it was all just failing
related_quotes: I think about sixth grade : : :that’s when I lost confidence a lot, ’cause I started failing and stuff cause stuff started getting harder and then I just started quitting and then the grades like dropped drastically, everything went from like Bs to like not even Cs, it was all just failing.

behavior_patterns.condition: regardless of socioeconomic status, parent education, level of parental involvement, or intellectual capacity
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: student disengagement and a sense of futility
